context_en:
Coffee gets us going in the morning, and beer rounds off the evening! 🍻

Beer is another love we share. Living in Belgium, how could we miss out on all the wonderful beers here?

We've only kept a few cute bottles we couldn't bear to throw away. The rest… we finished long ago! 😆 Come visit us in Belgium—there'll be plenty of beer waiting for you! 🍻
context_ch:
早上靠咖啡開機，晚上當然要靠啤酒收尾啦！🍻

啤酒也是佑琦和竹平的共同愛好，住在比利時，怎麼能錯過這裡各式各樣的好喝啤酒呢！

這裡只留下了幾個捨不得丟的可愛瓶子，其他的嘛……早就喝光光啦！😆 歡迎來比利時找我們玩，保證有滿滿的啤酒等著你們！🍻
